text:
Ivy: Heads up  alerting showed a small but sustained increase in TLS client handshake resets in eu-west and ap-south starting ~6155569999. Posting here for triage.
Diego: seeing it too; nginx logs show 'alert: tls: remote error: tls: bad certificate' on a subset of backends.
Priya: any recent RBAC/KMS changes? We had the key-policy tightening yesterday.
Ivy: yes, we merged a change to narrow keystore:unwrap to 'svc-keystore' principals, but the policy used a global principal name that didn't include regional aliases.
KMSBot: [alert] KMS:Decrypt DENY events: principal=svc-keystore-eu-alt req=req-a12, req=req-a14 at 6155570010.
Diego: that matches the traffic pattern. The keystore attempted to unwrap leaf certs and failed, causing proxied TLS handshakes to abort.
Priya: Can we temporarily grant a limited, auditable access back while we fix the policy? Prefer region-scoped rule with MFA/short TTL.
Ivy: propose: grant keystore:unwrap on resource arn:keystore:eu:leaf/* to principal svc-keystore-eu-alt with condition request.tag=rotation and ttl 6155573600. Minimal.
Compliance: Need to capture justification and attach to the audit ticket before policy is applied. Use the emergency RBAC template.
Priya: I'll take compliance note. Diego, can you switch proxy to use pinned certs for 10m to reduce handshake churn? Command: ```kubectl annotate deployment proxy-eu pinned-cert=true --overwrite```
Diego: done. Pinned certs enabled. Hit count of handshake resets downward on the dashboard.
Ivy: Creating scoped grant now: `iam-policy grant --principal svc-keystore-eu-alt --action keystore:unwrap --resource "arn:keystore:eu:leaf/*" --condition "tag:request=rotation" --ttl 6155573600 --audit=high`
KMSBot: [info] policy apply OK id=pol-224 at 6155570124.
KMSBot: [info] KMS:Decrypt SUCCESS req=req-a17 principal=svc-keystore-eu-alt key=eu/leaf-2026 at 6155570131.
Diego: handshakes recovering; errors dropping to baseline. :white_check_mark:
Ivy: Follow-ups: (1) revert to stricter policy after full RCAs, (2) add regional principal mapping to RBAC change checklist, (3) add a CI preflight job that simulates unwrap per-region.
Priya: I'll add the mapping check to CHANGELOG template and create an issue for CI preflight. Issue: https://issues/RED-9981.
Compliance: Uploaded justification doc into the audit ticket with timestamps and TTL. Link: https://intra/audit/RED-9981-evidence
OpsOnCall: Saved rollback snippet if needed: `iam-policy revoke --change-id=pol-224`
Ivy: Also, add an alert rule: any KMS:Decrypt DENY for keystore principals in prod triggers P0 paging. Diego, can you add that to pager policy?
Diego: adding now. Rule pushed.
KMSBot: [audit] policy-change author=Ivy action=grant resource=arn:keystore:eu:leaf/* principal=svc-keystore-eu-alt ttl=6155573600 condition=tag:request=rotation at 6155570140
Ivy: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread open until CI preflight is in place and the RCA is posted.
Priya: RCA draft will include timeline, diff of the RBAC change, and suggested pipeline gate. I'll ping when ready.
Ivy: Good work. Closing active triage but keeping followups.
